2026-10-24. Root construction with complementary native mathematical checks.
All earlier one-mode, Green, spin, fermion, memory and record-law files preserved.
Historical novelty and a practical advantage over the strongest incumbents: UNKNOWN.

1. THE SCIENTIFIC CHANGE
========================
The one-mode photon-added thermal cone cannot simply be promoted to a positive
matrix polynomial on coherently coupled modes. A single local loss already
destroys positivity of that coefficient matrix. A finite positive state on a
Gaussian purification repairs the defect and gives evaluable completely positive
updates for Gaussian dynamics, no-count intervals and registered linear jumps.

This is useful structure, but finite core degree alone is not an economical
current state: positive mixtures over Gaussian backgrounds can be expensive.
The stronger continuation therefore includes a controlled nonlinear block,
with a real physical effect that persists at high occupation. In a suitable
purification, weak number-number interactions become a classical nonlinear
amplitude transport plus an explicit quadratic-in-small-parameter correction.
The amplitude is reconstructed as a POSITIVE quantum density. Its error controls
the entire future record of any common physical instrument, not just moments.

The conceptual mechanism has a close established predecessor: McCaul, Zhdanov
and Bondar, PRA108,052208 (2023), arXiv2302.13208v4. Their waveoperator,
purification, ancillary gauge, Bopp/Moyal and Koopman constructions are not new
discoveries here. The scoped work is a constructive current-state interface,
specific closure failures, occupation-uniform quantitative nonlinear bounds,
finite positive updates, and a certified physical-record consequence.

The completed rendered return and all four pinned attachments are preserved in [the Pro 1 source directory](source/dispatch/P1_coupled_predictive_sources_1541_20261024/). 2026-10-24. Root proof. Previous proof/code/data remain unchanged.

SCOPE
=====
This is a conditional mathematical construction for a supplied physical model.
The main theorem covers arbitrary physical initial preparations, simultaneous
number-conserving hopping/density interactions, ordinary unscaled equal loss,
and calibrated sparse observation under a common implemented feedback policy.
It proves complete permitted RECORD accuracy, not physical-state trace
reconstruction from a classical mixture. Physical access, initial/controller
correlations, numerical precision and potentially exponential mode dependence
are retained. Historical novelty and practical superiority remain UNKNOWN.

The canonical physical Husimi law replaces the earlier purification-amplitude
diagonal. A backward-effect argument needs no derivatives of the preparation.
Ordinary loss bounds accumulated nonlinear sensitivity and the remaining count
budget. A separate heterodyne interface can acquire initial finite cell weights
and a probability-tail certificate; no such experiment was performed here.
This does not use P3's coherent-overlap verifier or establish that composition.

bounded on each exposed record prefix. The Hamiltonian always commutes with
